findings.name: Life.stencil
findings.said: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect full sequential traversals of linked lists. Repeated List.get from the same head at successive increasing indices is not used to visit all elements: each lookup retraverses the prefix and the full walk is quadratic. Walk the remaining list tail directly. A single lookup, a fixed small number of lookups, indexing an actual random-access Array or Vec, or indexing only into a shrinking suffix with a fixed index is allowed. Base List.get is a linear linked-list lookup, not an array operation. Require visible repetition across a length controlled by that input. If absent, this rule holds.
